name: io.github.melhzy/pubmed-stream
title: pubmed-stream
description: Search PubMed and PMC, read full texts, map evidence and build Obsidian knowledge graphs

environmentVariables.name: NCBI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional free NCBI API key, which raises NCBI's limit from 3 to 10 requests a second; create it under API Key Management at https://account.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/settings/

environmentVariables.name: NCBI_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional contact email that NCBI asks programs to send with their requests
